_comment: Source of truth for GitHub Project Gantt setup. Priority options (project uses): p0, p1, p2. Size options: xs, s, m, l, xl. Estimate is in hours. Iteration titles must match iterations created in the project settings.

phases.title: Phase 0: Research and Methodology
phases.focus: Literature review (Tor, P2P, anonymity, OnionShare), materials and methods, proof-of-concept design for anonymous file sharing via Tor.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 0.1.1: Report 1 – Ficha Cadastral
sub_milestones.description: Initial registration document (ficha cadastral) for the research project, establishing project identity, scope, and institutional registration.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 0.1.2: Report 2 – Revisão Bibliográfica
sub_milestones.description: Bibliographic review covering Tor/onion services, P2P anonymity networks, OnionShare, and related censorship-resistance literature. References: Dingledine et al., P2P surveys, Docs/onionshare/README.md and how-onionshare-works.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 0.1.3: Report 3 – Sumário e Primeiro Capítulo Teórico
sub_milestones.description: Write the table of contents (sumário) and the first theoretical chapter, covering background theory on anonymity, Tor architecture, P2P systems, and related work.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 0.1.4: Report 4 – Documento de Projeto
sub_milestones.description: Write the full project document (documento de projeto): methodology, materials and methods, POC design for anonymous file sharing via Tor, Option A vs Option B analysis for OnionShare integration in AlLibrary.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 0.1: Literature Review
sub_milestones.description: Write the Introduction and Revisão Bibliográfica (Literature Review) sections covering Tor/onion services, P2P anonymity, and OnionShare as related work. References: Tor design (Dingledine et al.), P2P surveys, Docs/onionshare/README.md and how-onionshare-works.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 0.2: POC Design and Implementation Plan
sub_milestones.description: Write the Materiais e Métodos section and design the proof-of-concept for anonymous file sharing via Tor (onion v3 + Axum HTTP server, optional tracker, chunked transfer, optional XChaCha20-Poly1305). Deliverable: POC design document and Option A vs Option B recommendation for AlLibrary per Docs/onionshare/onionshare-rust-port/README.md.

phases.title: Phase 1: Project Foundation
phases.focus: Technology stack setup (Tauri v2 + SolidJS + SQLite), basic infrastructure, initial UI framework, development environment.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 1.1: Project Setup
sub_milestones.description: Tauri v2 + SolidJS project initialization, TypeScript configuration, ESLint/Prettier, Git setup, build pipeline, and development environment. See Milestones/phase2/milestone1.1_project_setup.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 1.2: Core Infrastructure
sub_milestones.description: SQLite database foundation, basic file storage system, initial error handling framework, Tauri backend service foundation. See Milestones/phase2/milestone1.2_core_infrastructure.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 1.3: Basic UI Framework
sub_milestones.description: Initial HomePage and SearchPage implementation, basic navigation and routing system, SolidJS frontend framework setup. See Milestones/phase2/milestone1.3_basic_ui_framework.md.

phases.title: Phase 2: Architectural Restructuring
phases.focus: SOLID architecture, mandatory component hierarchy (foundation→domain→composite→pages), cultural framework (5-level sensitivity), security infrastructure, service layer and database integration.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 2.1: Component Hierarchy Restructuring
sub_milestones.description: Fix SOLID violations: establish foundation→domain→composite→pages hierarchy, create src/types/ and src/hooks/, strict TypeScript mode. Week 1. See Milestones/phase2/phase1_summary.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 2.2: Cultural and Security Infrastructure
sub_milestones.description: Implement 5-level cultural sensitivity system, cultural validation pipeline, input validation, malware scanning integration, content protection mechanisms. Week 2.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 2.3: Service Layer and Database Integration
sub_milestones.description: Build comprehensive service architecture following SOLID principles, finalize SQLite schema with cultural metadata, establish service layer contracts and error handling. Week 3.

phases.title: Phase 3: Foundation Components & Document Management
phases.focus: Foundation UI component library, document management system with cultural classification, local search and collection organization.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 3.1: Document Management System
sub_milestones.description: Implement document import with cultural classification, document storage with cultural metadata, document preview with sensitivity controls, document lifecycle management. See Milestones/phase3/milestone2.1_document_management.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 3.2: Local Search
sub_milestones.description: Implement local search with cultural filtering, collection management with cultural grouping, tagging system with cultural context. See Milestones/phase3/milestone2.2_local_search.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 3.3: Collections and Organization
sub_milestones.description: Build collections and organization features: tagging, grouping, sorting with cultural context as information only. See Milestones/phase3/milestone2.3_collections_organization.md.

phases.title: Phase 4: P2P Network & Cultural Protocols
phases.focus: P2P infrastructure with multi-transport peer connections, Tor overlay (onion v3 hidden services as peer IDs), content distribution and replication, network search aggregation.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 4.1: P2P Network Setup
sub_milestones.description: Implement multi-transport peer connections, peer identity/address system, connection management, Tor overlay integration (Rust Arti or tor binary + SOCKS5). See Milestones/phase4/milestone3.1_p2p_network_setup.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 4.2: Content Distribution
sub_milestones.description: P2P content replication with integrity verification (hashes), cultural metadata as information-only labels, document distribution protocol. See Milestones/phase4/milestone3.2_content_distribution.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 4.3: Network Search
sub_milestones.description: Federated search across peers, result aggregation with cultural labels (no access filtering), network health monitoring. See Milestones/phase4/milestone3.3_network_search.md.

phases.title: Phase 5: Advanced Features
phases.focus: Advanced document features (annotations, version history, format conversion), smart collections, advanced search with cultural annotations.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 5.1: Advanced Document Features
sub_milestones.description: Document annotations, version history, format conversion (PDF/EPUB/etc.), advanced metadata management. See Milestones/phase5/milestone4.1_advanced_document_features.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 5.2: Smart Collections
sub_milestones.description: Smart/dynamic collections based on rules and cultural context, collection sharing, collection discovery. See Milestones/phase5/milestone4.2_smart_collections.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 5.3: Advanced Search
sub_milestones.description: Full-text search, semantic search with cultural annotation, faceted search, search history. See Milestones/phase5/milestone4.3_advanced_search.md.

phases.title: Phase 6: Security & Anti-Censorship
phases.focus: Complete TOR integration (transport toggle, IPC hardening), OnionShare integration (anonymous share/receive over Tor, Option B Rust port: tor_manager + Axum + Tauri commands), security hardening, API/plugin surface.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 6.1: Performance Optimization
sub_milestones.description: Caching strategies, database query optimization, search performance, resource management. See Milestones/phase6/milestone5.1_performance_optimization.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 6.2: Security Implementation
sub_milestones.description: TOR transport toggle, Tauri IPC hardening, input sanitization audit, security headers, complete security validation pipeline. See Milestones/phase6/milestone5.2_security_implementation.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 6.3: Offline Support
sub_milestones.description: Offline-first architecture, local cache management, sync strategies, graceful degradation. See Milestones/phase6/milestone5.3_offline_support.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 6.4: OnionShare Integration
sub_milestones.description: Anonymous file share and receive over Tor (Option B Rust port): extend tor_manager, Axum routes for share/receive, Tauri commands start_onion_share/stop_onion_share/start_onion_receive/stop_onion_receive. Share mode first, then Receive mode. See Milestones/phase6/milestone6.4_onionshare_integration.md.

phases.title: Phase 7: Polish & Accessibility
phases.focus: UI enhancement with cultural themes, accessibility standards, user experience polish, user features.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 7.1: UI Enhancement
sub_milestones.description: Cultural themes, dark/light mode, animations, UI polish across all screens. See Milestones/phase7/milestone6.1_ui_enhancement.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 7.2: User Features
sub_milestones.description: User preferences, reading history, bookmarks, personalization, notification system. See Milestones/phase7/milestone6.2_user_features.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 7.3: Accessibility
sub_milestones.description: WCAG compliance, screen reader support, keyboard navigation, high-contrast themes, i18n groundwork. See Milestones/phase7/milestone6.3_accessibility.md.

phases.title: Phase 8: Testing & Documentation
phases.focus: Comprehensive testing (unit, integration, e2e, security, cultural scenarios), technical and user documentation, final polish.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 8.1: Testing Suite
sub_milestones.description: Unit tests (Rust + TS), integration tests, end-to-end tests (Tauri/Playwright), security tests, cultural scenario tests (info-only guardrails). See Milestones/phase8/milestone7.1_testing.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 8.2: Documentation
sub_milestones.description: User documentation, API documentation (Tauri commands), developer guides, contribution guidelines, in-app help. See Milestones/phase8/milestone7.2_documentation.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 8.3: Final Polish
sub_milestones.description: Performance profiling and fixes, crash fixes from testing, UI/UX final pass, release candidate preparation. See Milestones/phase8/milestone7.3_final_polish.md.

phases.title: Phase 9: Release & Community Launch
phases.focus: Community beta testing, final release preparation, deployment pipeline, post-release support, roadmap for future development.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 9.1: Release Preparation
sub_milestones.description: Version tagging, changelog, distribution packages (Windows/macOS/Linux via Tauri), signing, GitHub Releases. See Milestones/phase9/milestone8.1_release_preparation.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 9.2: Post-Release Support
sub_milestones.description: Community beta feedback collection, critical bug fixes, monitoring and telemetry (privacy-respecting), support documentation. See Milestones/phase9/milestone8.2_post_release.md.

sub_milestones.title: Milestone 9.3: Future Development Planning
sub_milestones.description: Roadmap v2 planning based on community feedback, backlog grooming, contribution guidelines for open-source launch. See Milestones/phase9/milestone8.3_future_development.md.
